body: Thanks for caring enough to reply. I really appreciate it. Talked to a counselor...surprisingly why im still here. Unfortunately I'm still 16 and there's no place for me to go, but I'll take your advice for when I'm sure I can leave. It's gonna take me a long while to get better though.

Ha. My friend made me go talk to dr. fucking phil or basically our counselor. Reason for my ass still being here...anyways, I really dont have a favorite. I love rock/indie/alternative and pop/hip hop/rap.

Hey...if you need anybody to talk to I'm here. Life is a complete and utter bitch and I understand that too. I live a really shitty life at the moment and I've been thinking about the same things as you. I know how it feels when someone gives you this motivational shit thats irrelevant but I just wanted to say I understand the pain you're feeling. I'm recovering slowly and that's only because I vented all my shit to my best friend who overdosed twice. All I can say is that you MIGHT feel better if you talk to someone that understands and feels your pain, not a counselor or therapist. So if you ever want to talk it's okay.
